title: Launch Truth, Security Headers & Tool Discoverability
status: Production release candidate; feature freeze active; external launch evidence gates remain open
summary: Shifted Watchdog from feature expansion to launch truth and discoverability. Closed stale strategy/audit work in Linear, hardened response and cache headers, stopped selling unavailable Teams seats and customer API access, documented the owner-contact data boundary, and shipped Phase 1 of the 45-tool discoverability project with a shared registry, searchable index, plan locks and desktop/mobile navigation. External Paddle Live, staging-role, restore, stale Stripe-function and legacy client-side Scanner security gates remain explicitly open.

items.detail: At least one quarter of the active list present at the start of the work session was completed or truthfully retired, with strategy/audit deliverables separated from unresolved engineering gates.
Root Vercel configuration now carries HSTS, nosniff, framing, referrer, permissions and report-only CSP headers plus explicit JSON, CSS and HTML cache policies.

Teams is no longer purchasable while seats/admin are unbuilt, and Pro+/Teams no longer advertise a customer API that does not exist. Agent, Pro and Pro+ annual billing remains available with yearly-first presentation.
Published a public and internal policy explaining that Watchdog sells property intelligence rather than arbitrary-parcel phone/email enrichment or skip tracing.
Created a 45-tool registry, searchable/filterable All Tools index grouped by user job, current-plan lock states, and desktop/mobile navigation entry points.
Canonical, Open Graph, Twitter and indexability metadata were restored to the pricing page after commerce copy changes.
New feature expansion is paused under NJW-86 except launch blockers, NJW-77 Phase 1 discoverability and real-customer breakage.

Legacy Appeal Prospect Scanner still performs paid computation against static JSON in the browser; controlled Paddle Live/four-role/restore evidence is incomplete; stale Stripe Edge Function/secrets require external removal capabilities.
